content: Once data collection for the current round is finished, we construct a new training set from the collected data, with accompanying development and test sets. While the training set includes correctly classified examples, the development and tests sets are built solely from them. The test set was further restricted so as to: 1) include pairs from “exclusive” annotators that are never included in the training data; and 2) be balanced by label classes (and genres, where applicable). We subsequently train a new model on this and other existing data, and repeat the procedure three times.
